# Roukh Entity & ORRERY Framework

Identity/mission framework behind this workspace (context, not a build spec):

**ORRERY** names three distinct things — conflating them is the first error:
1. ORRERY-the-mission: the cognition pillar of a three-axis life project (infinite life, infinite energy, infinite cognition).
2. ORRERY-the-software: the second-brain product (this workspace) — branching AI instances, plastic↔rigid rigidity controls against agreeable-assistant drift.
3. ORRERY-Systems: the seven-layer skills architecture below.

**Roukh entity**: the operating term for self-as-system — the longitudinal skill stack + values + infrastructure, not the person day-to-day. "The architect" refers to this entity. At its center is "the singularity": a contentless internal node, the only part actively protected, that the three mission pillars (infinite life / energy / cognition) instrumentally serve. Explains 30-year bets over 3-year ones.

**Seven-layer skills architecture (v1, locked)**: 1. Cognitive OS, 2. Formal Language Tools, 3. Building, 4. Capital, 5. Human-Systems, 6. Info-at-Scale, 7. Strategic & Orchestration. Priority: Amber (build yourself — layers 1,2,5,6, irreducibly personal) vs Teal (buyable, GHOBZ-adjacent — layers 3,4,7, delegation viable). Teal funds the time to compound Amber; Teal is execution-upstream even though Amber is value-upstream.
